info.name: Meghali's Silk — Laravel API (core.meghalisilk.in)
info.description:
Postman v2.1 collection for the Meghali's Silk Laravel + MySQL backend, generated from the frontend's
service layer (src/services/api.js, Laravel branch) and db.json. Base URL: {{base_url}} =
https://core.meghalisilk.in/api/v1. Companion to backend-developer-guideline/api-creation-guide.md.

Run order: 01 → 30 (logins first; create requests store ids in collection variables for later
update/delete requests). Every /admin/* request uses Bearer {{admin_token}}; customer requests use
Bearer {{token}}; public requests send no Authorization header. Every success body is
{ success: true, data }; every error body is { message, errors? }.

exec: // Nothing global; per-request auth is set explicitly.

item.name: 01 Authentication (customer)
item.description: Customer sign-up / sign-in. Login stores {{token}} and {{user_id}} for the rest of the run.

request.description: AuthModal → auth.register. Returns the safe user (no token). 422 when the email already exists.

request.description: AuthModal → auth.login. Saves data.token to {{token}}. remember only selects storage on the client.

const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("token", d.token); if (d.user && d.user.id != null) pm.collectionVariables.set("user_id", d.user.id);

AdminLogin → admin.login. Saves data.token to {{admin_token}}; data.admin persisted in sessionStorage by the client.
